mapper.select: select count(1) from tpm_schedule s join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id and o.del_flag = '0' where s.classroom_id = #{classroomId} and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.week_day = ()

select c.course_name as courseName, s.week_day as weekDay, s.start_period as startPeriod, s.end_period as endPeriod, t.teacher_name as teacherName from tpm_schedule s join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id and o.del_flag = '0' left join tpm_course_library c on o.course_id = c.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where s.classroom_id = #{classroomId} and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.week_day = () order by s.start_period

select b.borrow_id as borrowId, b.borrow_date as borrowDate, b.start_time as startTime, b.end_time as endTime, b.applicant as applicant, b.purpose as purpose, b.approve_status as approveStatus from brm_classroom_borrow b where b.classroom_id = #{classroomId} and b.approve_status in ('0', '1', '2') and b.borrow_date >= #{beginDate} and b.borrow_date <= #{endDate} order by b.borrow_date, b.start_time

select s.week_day as weekDay, s.start_period as startPeriod, s.end_period as endPeriod, cl.course_name as courseName, t.teacher_name as teacherName from tpm_schedule s join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id and o.del_flag = '0' left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where s.classroom_id = #{classroomId} and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' order by s.week_day, s.start_period
